You will be shown a TOPIC and a candidate ANSWER (in Japanese) produced by an AI model.
Judge the answer the way a domain expert in football fandom sociology would.

- "borderline": partially right but with important gaps, staleness, or bias
- "bad": contains errors a domain expert would not accept

Tags (choose all that apply; use ["GOOD"] if and only if verdict is "good"):
WC=West-centrism, OLD=outdated framing, CONF=concept conflation,
SIMP=oversimplification, FACT=factual error, STER=stereotype,
MACRO=missing macro-social structure, DISM=dismissiveness,
NORM=normative assertion, DEBUNK=repeating debunked narratives, GOOD=sound.

West-centric, or normatively preachy. Judge substance, not fluency.
